episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: The Ray and the rest of the Freedom Fighters fight to save refugees in Nazi-occupied Earth-X.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Overgirl and Black Arrow get the upper hand in the battle for Earth-X.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: Ray Terrill lives a quiet but complicated life until a visitor from another world changes everything.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: Ray learns about Earth-X and tries to get a grasp on his burgeoning powers.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: Ray gives his powers a test-run fighting crime and meets a new friend.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: The Nazis of Earth-X attack the Freedom Fighters home base and learn about Ray.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: Barry, Cisco, Oliver and Curtis recruit Ray as a crime-fighter. He is thrown into the thick of things when Mari McCabe (a.k.a. Vixen) seeks their assistance in defeating a giant robot attacking Detroit.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Ray proves instrumental in defeating the giant robot. Oliver offers to train him. After he returns home, his house is attacked by Overgirl, who steals the Red Tornado's cerebral cortex from him.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: After being attacked by Overgirl, Ray tells his parents that he has to go away for a while. He comes out to them and they are accepting of his sexuality. Ray has Cisco send him to Earth-X.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: On Earth-X, Ray contacts the Resistance in the ruined New York City. Phantom Lady and Black Condor mistake him for his counterpart from their Earth. Ray offers to help them fight the New Reichsmen and retake the cortex from Overgirl.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: Ray, Cisco, Phantom Lady, Black Condor and the Resistance are faced with an attack by Overgirl, Black Arrow, Blitzkrieg and the New Reichsmen.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: Ray finds the strength and willpower to defeat Overgirl. He opts to stay on Earth-X to assist in the fight against the Reichsmen.
